head: codex/708-runtime-agent-orientation-resource
title: Runtime: inject versioned Polis welcome package into agent context
body:
Closes #708

## Summary
- Add a first-class Runtime agent-orientation resource so newly started agents receive the Axioma Polis welcome package before task-specific content.
- Preserve Runtime-internal A2A routing and Layer8 authority while exposing non-authoritative orientation provenance in roster, feed, and Observatory surfaces.
- Raise agent conversation text bounds from 4 KiB to 32 KiB per scalar/part, add multipart task/message inputs, and enforce a 64 logical-part / 256 KiB aggregate cap including scalar text.
- Stabilize the duplicate in-flight conversation regression with the existing test barrier so hosted runtime CI does not race a fixed sleep against duplicate delivery assertions.

## Validation
- `TMPDIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-worktrees/adl-issue-708-runtime-agent-orientation-resource/.tmp cargo fmt --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml --check`
- `TMPDIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-worktrees/adl-issue-708-runtime-agent-orientation-resource/.tmp cargo test --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml --lib`
- `TMPDIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-worktrees/adl-issue-708-runtime-agent-orientation-resource/.tmp cargo test --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml logical_message_parts -- --nocapture`
- `TMPDIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-worktrees/adl-issue-708-runtime-agent-orientation-resource/.tmp cargo test --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml conversation_task_input_accepts_32k_single_part_and_multipart_input -- --nocapture`
- `TMPDIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-worktrees/adl-issue-708-runtime-agent-orientation-resource/.tmp cargo test --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml provider_conversation_action_tests -- --nocapture`
- `TMPDIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-worktrees/adl-issue-708-runtime-agent-orientation-resource/.tmp cargo test --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml provider_conversation_tool_tests -- --nocapture`
- Earlier same-branch proof also passed `cargo check --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml --lib`, strict Clippy for `adl-runtime-kernel`, focused `agent_initiation`, and `agent_to_agent_model_action_from_conversation_delivers_peer_response`.

No paid-provider inference, live external communications, or AWS work was performed.
